role: Five frozen helper dependencies replaced by exact owned historical factories

reviews.decision: The frozen current-Material helper import has been removed in favor of a source-local owned historical factory. The complete owned factory declaration/body is identical to its immutable Material16 reference. All six owned factories execute as complete import-free modules, return fresh native Error objects with the historical messages and preserve six legacy barrel aliases. The five finite local caller imports bind to those actual factories in seven throw expressions. Twelve body/extra-statement/wrong-peer-route/missing-alias mutants fail; a local caller import alias passes. This is an owned replacement disposition of the frozen dependency use, not a claim that a current private helper is supported or that the entire component validation, native view, packed API or runtime-floor behavior has executed.
reviews.reviewer: Codex implementation-phase individual use review; independent audit pending
